name: Sleepless Abbot dialogue facts
notes: mw-e39.9: facts the abbot's dialogue (abbot-cradle, bible 5.12, 4.1 beats 11-12) reads and writes, and the dreamer mark Horn and Mirela read (bible 4.5, 7.3). abbot.fate is in endings.json and clatter.restored / clatter.fate in endings.json and rootcellar-dialogue.json.

facts.description: The abbot has spoken aloud for the first time: the Act III reveal (bible 4.1 beat 11). Set by abbot-cradle.
The player has entered the Cradle, where the abbot conducts (bible 4.1 beat 12). Expected writer: the Cradle scene (E26); switches abbot-cradle from the reveal to the Cradle talk.
The abbot's wraith body has been beaten in the Cradle fight. Expected writer: the wraith combat (E13); lets abbot-cradle resolve the Fight (abbot.fate defeated).
How the player took on the abbot in the Cradle (bible 4.1 beat 12); abbot.fate says how it ended. Set by abbot-cradle.

The player took the Vesper Bell's tongue back from the abbot (fight, trick or persuade; not join). Stand-in until the tongue is an item; expected reader: the belfry climb (mw-e39.4 follow-up). Set by abbot-cradle.
The player turned down the abbot's class-aimed gift (bible 4.5). Set by abbot-cradle.

The player accepted the abbot's help (sorcerer's Lull or any class's gift): Hushlings ignore them, they hear the song in town, Mirela knows and Horn trusts them less (bible 4.5, 7.3). Set by abbot-cradle; read by horn-warden and mirela-stacks.
